summary: Describes how routers that support SR-MPLS and routers that only handle IP can work together. SR-MPLS label stacks are carried across IP-only parts of the network by encapsulation or tunneling, such as MPLS-over-UDP, with no changes to the SR-MPLS specifications.

eli5.summary: Sometimes part of the trip has no special road, so you put the whole travel plan inside a plain box and ship it across. This explains that for routers.
